document.title: S Corporation Shareholder Stock and Debt Basis Limitations Worksheet (California, Form 100S)
document.revision_printed_as: Form 100S Shareholder Stock and Debt Basis Limitations Worksheet
document.issued_by: the S corporation's preparer, for the California return
document.notes: California's version of the federal stock-and-debt basis computation (the federal one is Form 7203 / shareholder-basis-records). California basis differs from federal basis wherever California does not conform, so this worksheet must never stand in for the federal basis record.

extraction.note: Out of this map's jurisdiction (US-CA). Classifiable so it can be named and held; deliberately not extracted federally.
